detail.title: Alarm KIT
detail.overview: Compare Favourite ART-ARC3000H-03-GW2 Alarm KIT Key Points · Supports 150 wireless peripherals (6 sirens, 64 wireless keyfobs). · Wired, Wi-Fi, or GPRS network connection. · Supports SOS emergency calls. · Frequency hopping function and two-way communication technology ensure communication stability. Sales Enquiry Datasheet

Input and Output.Wireless Protection Zone: Hub: 150-channel wireless peripherals (6 sirens, 64 wireless keyfobs)

Port.Button: Hub: 1 × reset, 1 × power, 1 × AP Keyfob: 4 (Home, Away, Disarm, and SOS) Door Detector: 1 × power button PIR Detector: 1 × power button
Port.Indicator Light: Hub: 1 for multiple statuses (alarm, arming, disarming, networking, and malfunction) Keyfob: 1 × two-color status indicator (green: normal, red: abnormal) Door Detector: 1 × green alarm indicator PIR Detector: 1 × green alarm indicator
Port.Network Mode: Hub: Ethernet, Wi-Fi and Cellular network (Supports installation of dual SIM cards. Only one card can be enabled at a time)
Port.Network Port: Hub: 1 × RJ-45 10 M/100 M Ethernet port

Function.Network Protocol: Hub: TCP/IP, including PPTP, L2TP, DHCP, UPNP, and NTP
Function.Tamper Alarm: Hub: Yes Door Detector: Yes PIR Detector: Yes
Function.User Management: Hub: Share function for App users
Function.Search: Hub: Searching push messages, device status, and program version. Detecting signal strength. Keyfob: Signal strength detection Door Detector: Signal strength detection PIR Detector: Signal strength detection

Wireless.Communication Distance: Hub: Up to 1,200 m (3,937.01 ft) in an open space Keyfob: Up to 500 m (1,640.42 ft) in an open space Door Detector: Up to 1,000 m (3,280.84 ft) in an open space PIR Detector: Up to 1,200 m (3,937.01 ft) in an open space

Cellular Network.Transmitter Power (EIRP): Power class0: 30 dBm±3 dB (GSM900) Power class5: 33 dBm±3 dB (GSM1800)

Temperature.Measuring Range (Temperature): Door Detector: –15 °C to +65 °C (+18.8 °F to +149 °F) (indoor) PIR Detector: –15 °C to +65 °C (+18.8 °F to +149 °F) (indoor)

Specification.Sensor: Door Detector: Reed switch PIR Detector: Dual elements low-noise PIR sensor
Specification.Test Mode: Door Detector: Yes PIR Detector: Yes
Specification.Detection Range: PIR Detector: 12 m (39.37 ft) (90°) with installtion height of 2.2 m (7.21 ft)
Specification.Detection Speed: PIR Detector: 0.3 m/s–3 m/s (0.98 ft/s–9.84 ft/s)
Specification.Two-way Digital Temperature Compensation: PIR Detector: Yes, no attenuation of detection distance in high temperature

General.Power Supply: Hub: 12 V DC, 1.5 A (Europe, UK and USA power adapters are optional) Keyfob: CR2032 battery Door Detector: CR123A battery PIR Detector: CR123A battery
General.Battery Life: Hub: Storage battery standby for 12 Hours Keyfob: 5 years Door Detector: 5 years PIR Detector: 4 years
General.Power Consumption: Keyfob: Max. 85 mW Door Detector: Max. 70 mW PIR Detector: Max. 75 mW
General.Operating environment: Hub: –10 °C to +50 °C (+14 °F to +122 °F) (indoor) Keyfob: –10 °C to +55 °C (+14 °F to +131 °F) (indoor) Door Detector: –10 °C to +55 °C (+14 °F to +131 °F) (indoor) PIR Detector: –10 °C to +55 °C (+14 °F to +131 °F) (indoor)
General.Installation: Hub: Wall mount; Desktop Door Detector: Bracket mount PIR Detector: Wall mount
General.Net Weight: Hub: 0.38 Kg (0.84 lb) Keyfob: 20 g (0.04 lb) Door Detector: 70 g (0.15 lb) PIR Detector: 100 g (0.22 lb)
General.Gross Weight: Hub: 0.8 Kg (1.76 lb) Keyfob: 65 g (0.14 lb) Door Detector: 115 g (0.25 lb) PIR Detector: 170 g (0.37 lb)
